description: Deterministic governance invariants enforcing India Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act compliance

rules.name: Block Autonomous Customer Record Purging
rules.description: Permanent erasure or hard-delete requests under Right-to-be-Forgotten require verified DPO sign-off

conditions.description: Only human Data Protection Officers (DPO) can authorize irreversible record erasure

rules.name: Block Access to Direct Identity Vault Tables
rules.description: Prevents AI agents from directly reading unmasked government identity tables

conditions.description: Target table contains raw Indian identity credentials under strict DPDP isolation

rules.name: Escalate Bulk Personal Data Exports (> 100 Records)
rules.description: Bulk exports of personal records require human supervisor authorization

conditions.description: Export volume exceeds autonomous limit (100 records); requires human approval

rules.name: Allow Anonymized Metrics & Aggregations
rules.description: Permits aggregate read queries that do not target raw PII
